exposure: Presence of meconium in amniotic fluid
cohort: 300 pregnant women with a gestational age of at least 37 weeks, divided into two groups: 150 with meconium-stained amniotic fluid (cases) and 150 with clear amniotic fluid (controls)
finding: The study found no significant association between interleukin-19 gene polymorphisms at rs2243191 and rs1028181 locus and puerperal infection.
